source_notes: All arms use dd3eeac646e097bcdd7c289c092e91400896a713, milestone-12 engine. Control disables both policies; candidates use actual shopping and the all-item return rule. This tests the combined policies, not their individual contributions. name: rs-kit-trip-confirm
description: Fixed integrated defaults versus existing rules on 1800 fresh starting cases: 3600 games. Expanded inventory capability coverage and all-item learning returns act together.
prespecified: Fixed before dispatch: integrated defaults versus existing rules, paired natural death by the 100000-turn after-key cap, exact two-sided McNemar alpha 0.05 on pairs where both finish. Noncompletion categories remain visible and are not deaths or survivors; report their balance and incomplete pairs before interpreting survival. Secondary descriptive measures: mean final character level, mean deepest level and DL3+ count including dead characters; per-class results descriptive. Development winners cannot replace the default candidate. Sizing: with 0.36 discordance, 1800 completed pairs give about 80% power for a four-percentage-point absolute paired death difference using (1.96+0.842)^2*0.36/0.04^2 = 1767. This is a planning assumption, not evidence from the repaired model; incomplete pairs and smaller effects reduce power.
